# 📦 GeoFluent Windows 11 Build Packages

This directory contains the production packages generated for Windows 11:

| Package File | Format | Target Platform | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GeoFluent-Setup-1.0.0.exe` | NSIS Executable Installer | Windows 10/11 (x64) | Full installation wizard with Start Menu and Desktop shortcuts |
| `GeoFluent-Portable-1.0.0.exe` | Standalone Executable | Windows 10/11 (x64) | Zero-install standalone executable |
| `GeoFluent-1.0.0.msi` | Microsoft Windows Installer | Windows 10/11 (x64) | MSI package for enterprise system administration and silent deployment |
| `GeoFluent-1.0.0.appx` | Windows AppX Package | Windows 10/11 (x64) | Universal Windows Platform format for sideloading and Microsoft Store |
| `GeoFluent-1.0.0.msix` | Windows 11 MSIX Package | Windows 11 (x64) | Modern containerized package for Microsoft Store publishing |

### Verification & Checksums
All binaries are compiled with 64-bit architecture, targeting Windows 10 (Build 17763) up to Windows 11 (Build 26100+).
